note: Blob key only. This build's hsw/hsj AES-256-GCM keys were never captured, so no hsw or hsj section is present.

blob.wire: base64(iv(16)) + "." + base64(ct(N)), IV is 16 bytes from crypto.getRandomValues
blob.sealed_in: bundle JavaScript, not the WASM module
blob.verification: Byte-identical to the plaintext tapped out of the same run's BlobEncryption.encrypt, and it opens an earlier uninstrumented run's fingerprint_blob with valid PKCS#7 padding.
blob.extraction_method: blank the five T-tables at seal time so the block function returns the last round key for any input, read it off the emitted blob, then invert the AES-128 key schedule
